newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian Vintage in A$25 mln issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian Vintage in A$25 mln issue.

text.p: Winemaker Australian Vintage Ltd said it would hold a one for two renounceable rights issue of 12.303 million shares at A$2.04 per share to raise A$25.10 million.
The issue would be underwritten by McIntosh Corporate Ltd and Porter Western Capital Markets Pty Ltd and the sponsoring broker was Taylor Collison Limited, Australian Vintage said.
Australian Vintage Chairman David Clarke said in a letter to shareholders that the company had expanded its volume of production since listing two and half years ago.
He said Australian Vintage planned to upgrade processing capacity at its Loxton Cellars winery to 50,000 tonnes of fruit a year by 1998 from its current 10,000 tonnes a year.
"However, your company has no plans to expand capacity beyond 50,000 annual tonnes and proposes hereafter to focus on other means of adding value to its business," Clarke said.
The rights issue was designed to fund this winery upgrade expansion, the purchase of further varietal vineyards and stockbuilding.

"The additional investment required for varietal vineyard, winery upgrade and stockbuilding can only accelerate the growth of your company into a fully integrated, internationally oriented wine company," Clarke said.
Australian Vintage's shares closed two cents lower at A$2.23 on Monday.
